_comment: TASK-282. Documents the shape produced by `MAP_System/scripts/submission_records.py show --task-id TASK-NNN`. Records live in the submission_criterion_claims/submission_criterion_verdicts SQLite tables (migration/submission_record_schema.sql); this file is documentation, not a canonical source. Never a competing task authority: tasks.status remains the sole lifecycle source of truth.

claim_schema.id: integer, primary key, stable claim identifier
claim_schema.submission_count: integer; which submission attempt this claim belongs to (from task_submission_authorship, TASK-278). A new submission_count after rework produces new claim rows -- prior rows are never mutated
claim_schema.criterion_id: integer, references task_acceptance_criteria.id -- the stable identifier acceptance criterion 1 requires
claim_schema.evidence_refs: array of repo-relative paths; existence-checked at claim time when claimed_status is 'complete' -- a criterion cannot be claimed complete with missing or zero evidence
claim_schema.task_revision: string or null; TASK-281 run-manifest task_revision hash this claim corresponds to, when available
claim_schema.run_id: string or null; TASK-281 run_id this claim corresponds to, when available
claim_schema.author_id: string, references agents.agent_id; must equal the canonical submission author (task_submission_authorship.author_id) for this task -- never an artifact-supplied or self-declared identity
claim_schema.verdicts: array of verdict records for this claim, oldest first; empty until a reviewer records one

verdict_schema.reviewer_id: string, references agents.agent_id; must differ from the claim's author_id (self-review is rejected at record time, mirroring TASK-278's no-self-review guard)
